title: Engineering Fundamentals
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: Identify various engineering disciplines and the types of education and training needed to complete a degree, obtain a professional engineering license, and work as a professional engineer.

Use vector statics principles to analyze practical engineering problems including equilibrium of rigid bodies, force distribution, normal and shear stress applications, truss, frame, and cable force calculations and strain rate calculations.
Demonstrate understanding of programming concepts applicable to MATLAB and Excel VBA to solve practical engineering problems.
Identify the correct theory and apply the proper equations to calculate internal stresses, strains, and displacements of rigid members.
Demonstrate the use of differential and integral calculus for solving practical engineering problems.
